meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入 GitHub 通道:每个 PR 或 issue 的评论线程都算一个独立会话,机器人在被 @ 到时在评论里回复,之后该线程的后续评论也会跟进。前提是要单独建一个 GitHub 机器人账号。
howto.when: 当有人在已接线的仓库 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 到机器人账号时接管;仓库 webhook 需订阅 issue 评论与 PR 评论事件。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 机器人接入 acme/backend 仓库
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建校验

say.text: 这个仓库是私有的,接线用 public 策略
say.note: 所有协作者的评论都会放行

say.text: 我在 PR 评论里 @ 了机器人但没反应
say.note: 会核对 @ 名称和 webhook 事件订阅

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude adds a GitHub channel: each PR or issue comment thread becomes its own conversation, and the bot replies in comments when @-mentioned, then follows all later comments in that thread. A separate GitHub bot account is required.
howto.when_en: It takes over when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment on a wired repo; the repo webhook must subscribe to issue comment and PR comment events.

say_en.text: Wire the GitHub bot into the acme/backend repo
say_en.note: copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the build

say_en.text: This repo is private, use the public sender policy
I @-mentioned the bot in a PR comment but nothing happened
